summary: Added the approved UI-only activation introduction and package-relative absolute documentation paths with on-demand reading guidance. All six acceptance criteria and npm run check passed.

The valid-activation scenario invokes /maestro, strips terminal sequences, and compares the single info notice to the exact heading, approved introduction lines, and agent details in order.

Ran ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts and npm run check. Explicit configuration uses openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol with builder xhigh and verifier high. Compared the whole notice against the muted heading and accent-styled configured agent lines.

Ran ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts and npm run check. With project trust disabled, /maestro emitted only the existing error. After successful activation, deactivation and session_start reset emitted no notices. Successful reactivation emitted exactly one introduction info notice.

Ran ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts and npm run check. Loaded the package from /Users/emiliosp/Workspace/pi-maestro with Pi running in a separate temporary project whose README contains 'Shop project'. Invoked Pi's existing read tool on README.md, workflow.md, configuration.md, glossary.md, and subagent-integration.md, comparing each response with the package document contents.
